generated_projection.rule: derive exact sorted edge set from every gate prerequisite/workstream/day/impact tuple and compare byte-for-byte; omitted_dependency_count is computed from registry reference closure
generated_projection.schedule_term: fourteen implementation days after Day-0 authorization; pre-Day-1 closure outside clock
generated_projection.day11: pre-release restore contract and rehearsal only
generated_projection.post_day12: exact-tuple physical acceptance and exact-release rollback/restore sibling proofs before one-phone canary admission

dependency_invariants: every non-root gate has a semantic prerequisite
G-PHYSICAL-ACCEPTANCE and G-EXACT-RELEASE-RESTORE are sibling post-admission proofs
G-CANARY-ADMISSION requires G-RELEASE-ADMISSION plus both sibling proofs
G-RELEASE-ADMISSION never depends on either post-admission proof; no reverse edge is permitted
omitted dependency count is computed, never asserted

h05_release_order.day11_scope: G-RESTORE is the pre-release restore contract and rehearsal gate only
h05_release_order.invariant: release admission never depends on physical acceptance or post-release proof; final proof never accepts Day-11 rehearsal evidence
